name: Katashiro Ryousuke
original_name: カタシロ・リョウスケ
source:
A member of Glittering Crux's second section Vanishing Age squad. [url=/c82995]Head[/url]'s mark was originally his until he decided to give it to him. He was the fiancee of [url=/c80912]Takuto[/url]'s mother Sora, but he gouged out his left eye when he found that [url=/c82995]Head[/url] was having an affair with her. Despite his cold attitude, Ryousuke really did love Sora, and has been shown to be fond of her son as well as [url=/c80914]Sugata[/url] and [url=/c80913]Wako[/url].

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Star_Driver_characters##Glittering_Crux_Brigade]Wikipedia[/url].]
